    Mesh-matrix evaluation of additive label weights #

    The categorical Euler defect of a label weight on a chosen right mesh is the corresponding weighted column sum of the mesh matrix. This identifies the matrix unit equations in the frozen manuscript with Iyama's positive right-additivity hypothesis.

    source

    ∑ source : Ind, ↑(arrowMultiplicity T.toFiniteRightTauCategoryData source target) * weight source = ∑ i : Fin (rightMiddleArity T.toFiniteRightTauCategoryData target), weight (rightMiddleLabel T.toFiniteRightTauCategoryData target i)
